title: Hybrid Approach to Fabricate Uniform and Active Molecular Junctions

nodes.label: Sub-5 nm metal-molecule-metal junctions need uniform, well-defined gaps that evaporated contacts cannot give

requires_unseen: roughness and metal penetration of thermally evaporated contacts prevent a well-defined structure

nodes.label: A room-temperature hybrid route can build uniform active junctions whose top contact stays mechanically free to move

requires_unseen: the top contact is mechanically free to respond to an externally applied stimulus

nodes.label: A nanorod top contact bridges two laterally spaced ultrasmooth bottom electrodes across a <5 nm molecular gap
Template-strip lithographically patterned Au from a fluorinated Si/SiO2 wafer instead of using as-evaporated Au

attrs.text_value: peeled Au roughness ~0.6 nm vs ~2 nm as-evaporated (linked text)

nodes.label: Pattern Au electrodes on Si/SiO2, fluorinate, bond to glass with UV-cured epoxy and peel the metal off
The peeled Au electrode surface is ultrasmooth over the whole electrode array

attrs.text_value: roughness ~0.6 nm vs ~2 nm as-evaporated (linked text); the height ranges are read from F4b and F4c

nodes.label: Self-assemble a PEG-thiol monolayer from solution onto the peeled Au bottom contacts

requires_unseen: PEG-thiol is self-assembled in the solution phase on the bottom contacts

nodes.label: A PEG-thiol monolayer bearing C-H and C-O groups is assembled on the peeled gold surface
Dielectrophoretically trap a colloidal Au nanorod so that it bridges the two bottom electrodes

requires_unseen: the nanorod top contact is introduced by dielectrophoretic trapping of a colloidal suspension

nodes.label: A uniform metal-molecule-metal junction forms between a flat nanorod facet and the ultrasmooth film, its gap set by the monolayer
The molecular layer is varied across devices: PEG-thiol, dodecanethiol and hexanedithiol
Sweep 0-3 V on the bottom electrodes with the nanorod left floating, repeating the sweep run after run

requires_unseen: the voltage is applied to the bottom electrodes and the nanorod is left floating

nodes.label: The applied voltage pulls the contacts together, compressing the monolayer and narrowing the tunnelling gap exponentially raising current

requires_unseen: the authors postulate an electrostatic force between the contacts

nodes.label: The PEG-thiol gap compresses to about 0.63 of its initial width by 2.4 V while the dodecanethiol gap stays unchanged
Repeated sweeping raises the gap conductance irreversibly in both the PEG-thiol and the dodecanethiol junction
Move to a device built from larger-diameter nanorods with a hexanedithiol molecular gap

requires_unseen: the larger-diameter nanorods of this design (Figure S4a, not in the packet)

nodes.label: Sweep the hexanedithiol device over consecutive runs within 0-2 V

requires_unseen: the reported mean is over 30 consecutive runs

nodes.label: The hexanedithiol device works stably: no hysteresis and a run-to-run spread narrower than the curve up to 2 V

requires_unseen: the plotted mean and sigma are taken over 30 runs

nodes.label: Template stripping, self-assembly and nanorod trapping together give uniform, electrically active and electromechanically tunable molecular junctions
Between thermally evaporated Au contacts the molecular gap is faint, irregular and locally pinched
Peeling in air tears the electrode ends, leaving transferred gold mounds and open voids

attrs.attributed_cause: triboelectric charging as the two surfaces separate (linked text)

nodes.label: Peel with the sample submerged in deionized water
The fitted Young's modulus is about 81 MPa for the PEG-thiol layer and about 0.97 GPa for dodecanethiol

requires_unseen: fitted moduli 81 MPa and 0.97 GPa from the Simmons best fits

nodes.label: The Simmons fit has too many free parameters for a unique solution, so the moduli are not uniquely determined

requires_unseen: it is not feasible to find a unique fit; other parameter combinations also fit

nodes.label: PEG monolayers are known to be compressible whereas dodecanethiol packs into a film of higher Young's modulus

requires_unseen: literature refs 21, 22 quoted in the linked text

nodes.label: Simmons tunnelling model with a voltage-dependent gap, barrier height Phi and parameter alpha

requires_unseen: the fitted parameters L, Phi, alpha, Y, epsilon_r

nodes.label: TEM cross-sections show a continuous bright molecular layer of even thickness between a flat nanorod facet and the smooth Au film

attrs.image_note: F5d shows the whole pentagonal rod cross-section on an unbroken layer; the top-view SEM F5c (opened, not cited) shows one rod overlapping both electrodes

nodes.label: In the evaporated-contact junction the gap line is faint, broken and locally pinched between grainy contacts

attrs.image_note: same 20 nm bar as F3b; the whole field is low contrast, so the gap is only intermittently resolved

nodes.label: After peeling a whole electrode array images uniformly over a 0-12 nm height range, against 0-120 nm before peeling

Peeled in air the electrode ends carry large torn gold mounds and dark voids; peeled in water the electrodes stay intact

nodes.label: The nano-FTIR spectrum carries a C-H bend near 1345 cm-1 and C-O stretches near 1240 and 1100 cm-1

attrs.image_note: spectrum averaged over several locations on the peeled gold (linked text); no absolute absorption scale is given

nodes.label: A uniform low-contrast shell about 2 nm thick against the 10 nm bar coats both sides of the Au nanorod
PEG-thiol run 1: current climbs about six decades to the 1 uA compliance by 2.5 V and the return branch runs up to three decades above the forward branch
Successive runs push both junctions to higher current: PEG-thiol hits compliance below ~1 V by run 12, dodecanethiol fans up to ~1 uA by run 100

attrs.image_note: the caption plots only select PEG runs; the dodecanethiol drift over 100 runs is as large as the PEG drift over 12

The variable-gap Simmons curve tracks the PEG run-1 forward sweep over four decades while the constant-gap curve falls up to two decades below it above 1.5 V

attrs.image_note: the same pair of dotted curves in F6b are only about half a decade apart at 3 V, so the discrimination is much weaker there

notes: Packet figure ids are offset from the paper's own numbering: F1 is the TOC graphic and F2 a journal-cover thumbnail (both with an empty caption and no scientific content), so packet F3-F7 are the paper's Figures 1-5. F7 is tier C and offers no crops, so its three readings (o14, o15, a1) carry figs=['F7'] with panel_ids=[]. The F6 caption is truncated mid-sentence ('Th ...'). The F4b OCR letter is read as 'q' where the panel is labelled 'b'; the crop is the right one (AFM arrays before/after peeling) and was cited as F4b. F3a and F5c were opened but not cited: F3a is a schematic used as the source of the design nodes n3-n5, and F5c duplicates o1's reading (noted in o1 image_note). Information lost: every supplementary figure (S1 AFM roughness, S4a larger rods, S5 bipolar sweeps, S6 the HfO2 control, S7 dark field, S8 above-2 V destabilisation) is referenced in the linked text but absent from the packet, so the stability argument rests on F6 and F7 alone. The argument has one control branch (n20, the evaporated-contact junction, contrasting n10) and one process-fix branch (n21 -> n22, peeling in water) off the main path.

split_nodes.why: The label stated two structural claims with different evidence: the array-wide ultrasmoothness (o3, colour-scale range 0-12 nm after vs 0-120 nm before) and the elimination of the lift-off edge burrs (o4, edge profile swing -15/+14 nm before vs +/-1 nm after; 'BURRRS' is annotated on the F4a schematic). The linked text states them as two separate consequences of peeling.

The label stated the figure-shown irreversible conductance rise (F6a/F6b, o9) and the text-only endpoint 'can end in shorting of the device'. The second clause is the fact listed in the node's own requires_unseen, so it could not sit on a source=figure node.

The label stated two separate down-selects taken from two different unseen observations: the larger-diameter-nanorod / hexanedithiol device design (Figure S4a) and the 0-2 V operating window (Figure S8). The paper draws the second as its own lesson ('the testing/operating conditions for each device design plays a significant role').
